description: Header file defining a utility class FixedDivisor for fast division and modulus operations with a known integer divisor, optimized for different architectures and including magic number calculations for signed 32-bit integers.

classes.name: FixedDivisor<std::int32_t>
classes.description: Specialized template class providing fast division and modulus operations for 32-bit signed integers, including magic number calculation for optimization.

methods.name: FixedDivisor(const std::int32_t d)
methods.description: Constructor initializing divisor and computing magic number if applicable.

methods.name: magic()
methods.description: Returns the magic number used for fast division.

methods.name: shift()
methods.description: Returns the shift amount used in magic division.

methods.name: DivMod(const std::int32_t n, std::int32_t* q, int32_t* r)
methods.description: Calculates both quotient and remainder for n / d.
